unequal_amplitudes.interpretation: Subtracting shared complex spectra amplifies relative error in the deliberately tiny row. At a 2^20 amplitude ratio the maximum tiny-row relative L2 is about 15.5%, while absolute error stays below 7.73e-7 and global relative L2 below 2.21e-7. This is retained as a conditioning limitation, not hidden by the global metric. Existing model gates remain decisive.
